custody_model: Reviewed first-party material describes Earn participation from assets held in the user's Mudrex account. It does not establish one universal legal-title, segregation or insolvency-priority model for all supported assets.
yield_source: Mudrex describes staking-oriented rewards for supported assets and later educational material also discusses lending activities. Yield source must therefore remain product/asset-specific rather than generalized.
risk_notes: Advertised or displayed yields are product terms, not verified realized returns or guarantees. Product mechanics and counterparty exposure may differ by supported asset.
